data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Giza was a goddess of the earth and the protector of the harvest. Her name means 'mother of wonder' or 'earth goddess'. She was often depicted as a woman with a cornucopia, symbolizing abundance and fertility. The name Giza carries the meaning “Mother of wonder” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Giza usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of wonder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
